summary: The change adds a persistent marketing campaign store with admin-only create/list/update/remove RPCs, the configuration and Pulumi wiring for the admin user-ID list, and one shared SqlDatabase for the app client. All three round-1 findings are fixed: the durable suite passes with the `id: userId ?? crypto.randomUUID()` fix, the MarketingLinks temp test now uses the correct import and fixture paths and passes, and the stale old-tests copies no longer run. Every changed line is covered except four Pulumi infra lines, whose exemptions I accept; the source logic is sound, so the change is ready.
